title: get_changes_since_for_chat computes new_state that is discarded
description: kith-store/src/message.rs: get_changes_since_for_chat() calls self.get_state() at line 613 and returns it as new_state in ChangesResult. However, the caller in kith-chat/src/message.rs queryChanges handler (line 892) only destructures (chat_changes.added, chat_changes.destroyed), discarding chat_changes.new_state entirely. Lock 2 then calls get_state() again (line 905). This results in one redundant SELECT query against state_counters on every queryChanges call that has changes. Low impact in Phase 1 but is a latent inconsistency: the store function computes something the caller never uses.
